# Elevation Studio — Diaspora Architecture & Home Design Nigeria

> Elevation Studio is a premier Nigerian architectural design and 3D visualization studio specializing in remote architectural planning, building design, and site masterplanning for Nigerians living in the diaspora (United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Europe, Middle East, and worldwide) who want to build, develop, or invest in residential or commercial property in Nigeria.

## Core Capabilities & Offerings
- **Remote Architectural Design**: End-to-end architectural planning conducted via remote video consultations, WhatsApp, and digital presentations without requiring clients to travel to Nigeria.
- **3D Visualisation & Rendering**: High-fidelity 3D architectural renders allowing diaspora owners to inspect exterior and interior design concepts before ground breaks.
- **Residential Masterplanning**: Custom design for modern private villas, duplexes, multi-unit apartments, multi-generational family estates, and luxury residences.
- **Site-Context Design**: Custom building plans optimized for plot dimensions, topography, tropical climate, orientation, and local building requirements across Lagos, Ogun, Abuja, Port Harcourt, and major Nigerian states.
- **5-Step Remote Process**:
  1. Discovery & Land Assessment
  2. Concept & Spatial Layout
  3. 3D Architectural Visualisation
  4. Design Refinement & Detail Development
  5. Final Architectural Documentation Package

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Can clients work with Elevation Studio from abroad?** Yes. Elevation Studio's workflow is explicitly structured for international remote clients.
- **Is travel to Nigeria required before starting a project?** No. Land survey plans, site photos, or coordinates can be shared digitally to launch design.
- **Does Elevation Studio design for existing land?** Yes. Designs are tailored to plot dimensions, orientation, and climate.
- **How are design reviews conducted?** Via scheduled video calls, high-res 3D renderings, floor plans, and digital feedback rounds.
